about: What every X12 transaction modeled on a sample shares. A transaction's own profile (x12-834.json, x12-835.json, x12-837.json) extends this one and says what repeats and what follows from what. The X12 syntax itself -- ISA/GS/ST and SE/GE/IEA, delimiters, SE01 counting the transaction -- is the reader's, not a profile's. Places are written the way the screen labels them: 'NM1*IL NM103' is NM103 of an NM1 whose NM101 is IL; 'HI HI01-2' is the second component of HI01.

loops.about: A segment in 'scoped' belongs to the last 'by' segment before it (whose address, whose birth date). Any segment in 'ends' closes the open loop segments; 'anchors' are the segments a config entry can scope by (loop_segment_id).

qualified.about: How many leading elements say what a segment is. DTP carries two: the date's meaning and its format.

structural.about: Segments whose values the structure carries: never proposed, never filled. Positions a 'derive' rule sets are left out of proposals as well.

member.about: Whose name, address and birth date a place's suggestion is for: loops with these NM101 qualifiers (74: an 835's corrected patient name). A place in any other loop (a provider, a payer) is suggested nothing.

places.about: What a place holds, when a config's algorithm name does not say. 'is': null marks a place that holds nothing SDM makes a rule for (a provider's tax ID is not a member's SSN, whatever a masking algorithm's name says). An entry with 'if' wins over the others when the segment's first occurrence in the sample has those values.

codes.about: Where a position's values have X12 codes (relationship M, D, S written 18, 19, 01; INS01 following from it): the shipped transaction descriptions in sdg/writers/edi_formats, read position by position.
